row_filters.empty_text: Text is empty after normalization and marker removal (782 of the 783 originally empty texts are fake).
row_filters.non_english: Not English (G3): >30% of letters outside the Latin script (Cyrillic, Arabic, ...), or, for texts with >= 20 words, more Spanish/French/German/Italian/Portuguese function words than English ones. Almost all such articles are fake, so they reveal the label.
row_filters.duplicate: Exact duplicate of the cleaned content of an article with a lower doc_id (the lowest is kept).
row_filters.conflicting_labels: The same cleaned content appears with both labels (all copies dropped).
